source.description: Accepted design comparison against baseline 0a949cf. The three changes are now implemented in the working tree with the agreed broader scope. These fixed previews record the design discussion; use the parent catalog for current behavior maps.

included: Original and Proposed share the same start and outcome. New transitions are marked proposed and never become available in Exploration.
Only the affected route is shown. System checkpoints are simulated; no product effects occur.
Native failed Write request, Min Mode, unchanged valid connection and recoverable storage. The current compound More → Reuse edge is expanded into its actual controls.
The shortcut must preserve saved request choices, validate connection identity and keep prior output. It must not call Save again or retry automatically.
omitted: This comparison is not an exhaustive UI or concurrency model. Open the parent atlas for other journeys.
No live app or usability testing, provider requests, account changes or automatic merging. This is the original design study, not the current app rendering.

Counts distinguish intentional controls from system events. Do not treat grouped transitions as measured clicks. Cancel/retry loops are retained as alternatives and excluded from the straightforward before/after route.

journeys.label: Current · More, Reuse, Run
journeys.description: Failed native text request in Min Mode; three deliberate controls before another request can start.

journeys.label: Proposed · Retry same request
journeys.description: One explicit Retry with the saved input/action/preset and unchanged valid connection. More → Reuse remains the edit path.

comparisons.label: EZ: put Retry beside the failure
comparisons.detail: Recommend first. Current: More → Reuse → Run. Proposed: Retry same request. Three intentional controls become one in this Min Mode fixture. A new request is still deliberate; the pending-history save remains. Reuse stays available for edits. Invalid saved model/account must block with setup guidance, never silently switch. Save again remains storage-only. Implemented in the working tree; native offline checks cover changed connections and missing input.
